title: Chapter 391 Collect Some Interest
content:
Chapter 391 Collect Some Interest

The scene fell into a brief silence for a moment.

At this moment, everyone's eyes were all focused on the boy.

Yue Chen, the current ancestor of the Yue clan, did not want him to follow the ancestor Yue Shi Shen to leave. As the leader of the clan, he knew very well what Yue Shi Shen did back then.

Even if he can guess some inside information, so what?

The moon clan can no longer stand the tossing.

This young man may have a happy ending when he stays in the moon tribe.

Yue Shi Shen looked slightly deeper, staring at the boy and said, "Child, you can think about it if you are willing to follow me, I,,,,"

Before the Yue Shi's myth was finished, Lu Daosheng, who was standing beside him, suddenly sneered: "What are you thinking about? Do you really think this child really admires you."

This sentence made Yue Shi Shen couldn't help but be slightly stunned.

Lu Daosheng glanced at Yue Shi Shen with disdain, then looked at the young man, "This child is a strong man!"

And Yue Shi God is the strongest person he can know.

You may ask, aren’t the gods in the land of Gods stronger than the Moon Kill God?

Haha, this young man will choose the land of the gods unless his head is kicked by a donkey.

He is a member of the Moon Clan.

"Boy, tell me your name."

"Moon Ming."

The boy looked straight into Lu Daosheng's eyes, and a vibrant spirit flashed in his translucent eyes.

"Okay, then are you willing to leave with me?"

Lu Daosheng asked directly.

"this,,"

Yue Ming hesitated a little, and unconsciously looked at the Yue Shi God and the clan leader beside him.

Yue Shi God's face looked a little ugly, but more so, he was still helpless.

Yue Chen, the leader of the Yue clan, narrowed his eyes slightly, but the objection was not so obvious.

In his heart, if Yue Ming really wants to leave here, it would be better to follow Lu Daosheng than to follow Yue Shi God.

More importantly, Lu Daosheng and Yue Shi Shen did not seem to be in the same group, they are just on the same path.

When Lu Daosheng saw that the boy was still hesitating, he smiled gently, lifted his right hand and slowly clenched it tightly.

In an instant, a terrifying pressure suddenly came to the field, pressing on the shoulders of the three of them like a mountain.

At this moment, even the strongest Yue Shi Shen couldn't help but sweat coldly, and his legs were slightly bent, but it was just a struggle.

Yue Chen and Yue Ming, who were beside him, had already lie on the ground and could not even speak.

Until the Yue Shi God was about to hold on and was about to kneel down on the ground, Lu Daosheng then put away his breath and looked at the few people with a faint smile.

He believed that at this moment, Yueming had a choice.

Sure enough, when Yueming stood up and looked at Lu Daosheng again, his eyes were full of respect.

This is the real strong man.

Sure enough, a mountain is higher than a mountain.

"Senior, boy Yueming, I'm willing to follow him."

"only,,"

Seeing that there was a hint of hesitation in Yueming's eyes, Lu Daosheng knew it, but he still asked, "What are your conditions?"

If this scene was seen by the people from the deserted city, I would be so angry that I could dig up my own ancestral tomb.

Being able to follow Lu Daosheng is already a blessing that has been cultivated in eight lifetimes, and he still dares to make requirements.

But when faced with this thoughtful young man from the moon tribe, Lu Daosheng still gave some special cases.

Yueming hugged his fists and said solemnly: "I hope that seniors can take action to protect the Moon Clan."

"oh?"

When Lu Daosheng heard Yueming's words, he was a little surprised.

"I thought you would ask me to help you destroy the land of the gods."

As soon as these words came out, the scene suddenly fell into ghostly silence.

After a long time, Yueming wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and said in a deep voice: "Senior, I have thought too much. It is also the wish of my predecessor."

"I will do what the ancestor has not done for him!"

"child,,"

Yue Shi Shen was on the side, his eyes were complicated, and at this moment, his heart had quietly changed.

"Boy, follow me in the future and don't cause trouble for me."

At this time, the patriarch of the Moon tribe who had been silent suddenly spoke.

Yue Ming was stunned for a moment, then nodded heavily.

In this way, Lu Daosheng took Yueming away.

Before leaving, Lu Daosheng set up an impeccable and solid barrier for the current Yue clan’s ancestral land, which could not make any moves for the Yue clan’s people to go out and enter, while foreign clans could not make any move.

At the same time, he also left a backup plan for the Moon Clan.

Walking in the endless starry sky, Lu Daosheng suddenly stopped.

Behind the left are Yueming and Yuekong God.

Lu Daosheng looked sideways at Yue Shi Shen and said, "Now, you should have thought it through, right?"

Yue Shi God was silent for a moment and nodded slightly.

"Since that's the case, let's separate."

Lu Daosheng glanced at Yue Shi God deeply, and then left with Yueming.

On the spot, Yue Shi Shen looked at the two who were leaving, and after a long time, he slowly smiled.

"What else can I worry about?"

On this day, countless worlds heard the bold laughter of the past again.

"The land of the gods, my Moon Killing God, is here again!"

"Moon Killing God?!"

"It's him, he still has the face to go?"

"Wait a minute, hasn't he already defected to the Land of Gods?"

Countless creatures looked at each other, their eyes full of confusion.

But soon, a huge sound of fighting came from the land of the gods and resounded throughout the world, and at the same time, it also resounded in the ears of every creature.

Moon kills God, Moon kills God!

In the final outcome, Yue Shi God still did not fall unexpectedly.

But without surprise, his name will resound in a short time in the world oppressed by the land of the gods.

His spirit of daring to resist is worth learning from countless creatures.

On the other side.

Lu Daosheng still walked in the starry sky with Yueming.

Yueming looked sad at this moment. Since he left, he had already guessed the ending of Yue Slayer God.

He was carrying too much and he was tired.

“It was also a relief for him.”

As if he saw Yueming's thoughts, Lu Daosheng suddenly spoke.

Upon hearing this, Yueming nodded, and his emotions quickly recovered, and his eyes became firmer again.

"Senior, where are we going now?"

Where to go?

Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment.

He originally planned to go to the land of the gods to find the pseudo-gods to settle the accounts first.

However, he was restrained by Yue Shi God halfway and went to the Moon Clan again. Now, he has changed his mind.

For him, the land of the gods was just a clown, and he had one thing he hadn't done.

As for the land of the gods.

Lu Daosheng sneered, then get some interest first.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng spread his hands with one hand.

A faint fluorescence slowly condensed.

"Go."

The fluorescence creeps and then shoots in one direction.

Meanwhile, the land of the gods.

"Hmph, just ants are trying to shake us."

"But regardless of this kind of ant, I have been a little uneasy recently. It seems that some powerful guy is eyeing us."

"Oh? How powerful is awesome guy?"

Several giant pillars that reach the sky are light and dark, and the communication is constantly happening.

And at this moment, a fluorescent light suddenly penetrated through the void without any warning and shot in.

Buzz —

Rumble!
